'''Glastroan wine''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage produced in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Glastro]] on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. The [[Ubooki brothers]] were fond of the beverage.
